RebelABTesting.TagDescription: Runs the experiments of this website that are in progress. Add it once, with a trigger that fires on every page.
RebelABTesting.TagMatomoOriginDescription: The address of your Matomo, as https://host[:port] without a path. The tag fetches the experiments from it.
RebelABTesting.TagMatomoOriginInvalid: The Matomo origin must look like https://host[:port], without a path.
RebelABTesting.InsertExperimentHelp: Add the tag "Rebel A/B Testing" once to a container in Matomo Tag Manager, with a trigger that fires on every page, and publish the container. The tag runs every experiment of the website that is in progress.
RebelABTesting.ErrorNameTooLong: The name of the experiment can be 255 characters at most.
RebelABTesting.ErrorNameExists: The website already has an experiment with this name.
RebelABTesting.ErrorDateFormat: The dates must be given as YYYY-MM-DD.
RebelABTesting.ErrorDateOrder: The first day must not be after the last day.
RebelABTesting.ReportHelpText: Visits per experiment. Open an experiment to see its variants: 1 is the original, 2 the first variant. A visit shows up once the reports are archived.
RebelABTesting.GoalsReportHelpText: Goal conversions by experiment, then variant, then goal. Open an experiment to see its variants, and a variant to see its goals.
RebelABTesting.ExperimentNotFound: This experiment could not be found. It may have been deleted.
RebelABTesting.FormHypothesisHint: What you expect and why, for example “A green button gets more clicks.”
RebelABTesting.TagHideTimeout: Hide the page for at most (milliseconds)
RebelABTesting.TagHideTimeoutDescription: On a visitor's first page the tag has to fetch the experiments. The page is hidden meanwhile, so that the original does not flash before a variant. 0 never hides the page.
RebelABTesting.ErrorTrafficShare: The share of visitors must be between 1 and 100.
RebelABTesting.ErrorTargetValue: Give the address to compare with, at most 1000 characters.
RebelABTesting.ErrorVariants: An experiment needs between 1 and 10 variants.
RebelABTesting.FormTargetValueHint: Compared with the whole address of the page, including https://.
RebelABTesting.FormTrafficShare: Share of visitors in the experiment (%)
RebelABTesting.FormTrafficShareHint: These visitors are split evenly between the original and the variants. The others get the original and are not counted.
RebelABTesting.FormVariantsHelp: Each variant is CSS, JavaScript or both, added to the page. Use CSS for how the page looks and JavaScript for what it does or says.
RebelABTesting.ListResultsHelp: Each experiment has a page with its result in the menu.
RebelABTesting.ResultChance: Chance to be better than the original
RebelABTesting.ResultNoConversions: No visit in the experiment has converted a goal yet.
RebelABTesting.ResultHelp: A variant is called better or worse on the primary goal when the chance is at least 95%. The other goals are shown without a verdict: with several goals, one of them reaches 95% by chance more often. A conversion counts from the moment the visit is in the experiment.
RebelABTesting.ErrorPrimaryGoal: The primary goal is not a goal of this website.
RebelABTesting.FormPrimaryGoalHint: The goal the experiment is judged by. Choose it before the start: a variant that is only called better on the goal that happens to look best has often just been lucky.
RebelABTesting.ResultPreviewHelp: A link shows its variant in your browser until you close the tab, whatever the state of the experiment. The visit is not counted. Anyone with the link can see the variant.
RebelABTesting.ResultHelpNoPrimaryGoal: A variant is called better or worse when the chance is at least 95%. This experiment has no primary goal, so every goal is judged, and one of several reaches 95% by chance more often. A conversion counts from the moment the visit is in the experiment.
RebelABTesting.ErrorDoor: A fake door needs a text, a message after the click and the element it is put next to. The CSS class can only have letters, digits, spaces, - and _.
RebelABTesting.FormKindHint: An A/B test compares variants of a page. A fake door adds a button to something that does not exist yet, to see how many visitors want it.
RebelABTesting.PlannerHelp: An experiment that is ended on the first good day often shows a difference that is not there. Work out the days here, and set the last day accordingly. Nothing in this section is saved.
RebelABTesting.PlannerVisits: Visits a day on the pages of the experiment
RebelABTesting.PlannerRate: Conversion rate of the primary goal today (%)
RebelABTesting.PlannerEffectHint: 10 means: a variant that converts 10% more often than the original. Smaller differences take much longer to find.
RebelABTesting.PlannerResult: Run for at least %1$s days: %2$s visits in each of the %3$s groups. With that, a difference of this size is found four times out of five.
RebelABTesting.PlannerUnknown: Fill in the three numbers to see the days.
RebelABTesting.DoorHelp: The button or link is added to the page for the visitors in the experiment. A click shows your message in its place and is counted.
RebelABTesting.DoorLabel: Text of the button or link
RebelABTesting.DoorMessageHint: Tell the visitor that this does not exist yet, for example “We are working on this. Thank you for showing interest.”
RebelABTesting.DoorSelector: Put it next to the element (CSS selector)
RebelABTesting.DoorSelectorHint: For example #main-menu or .product-actions. Nothing is shown or counted on pages without the element.
RebelABTesting.DoorCssClassHint: A class of your website, so that it looks like your other buttons or links.
RebelABTesting.DoorResultHelp: The range is where the true share lies with 95% confidence. It narrows as more visits see the fake door.
RebelABTesting.ResultSplitUneven: The visitors are not split evenly between the groups, far more unevenly than chance explains. Visitors are probably not assigned or counted as they should be, for example because a variant breaks the page or the tracking. Do not trust the result until this is found.
